body.x: Korea Nitto Denko Co., Ltd. (President John Oh) participated in the Future Innovation Tech Expo 2024 (FIX 2024), held at EXCO from October 23 to 26.

Korea Nitto Denko is a subsidiary of Japan’s Nitto Group, established in 1918 and boasting over 100 years of history. The company provides technologies and solutions that enhance productivity and quality across various industries, driven by its advanced core coating technologies. Since its establishment in April 2000, Korea Nitto Denko has supplied cutting-edge materials to diverse domestic sectors. It is consistently recognized for its outstanding brand value and strong customer loyalty.

At FIX 2024, Korea Nitto Denko showcased its fluoropolymer porous film (TEMISH), insulation materials (multi-layer laminates), and RDS (Radio Diffusion Structure). The company also provided live demonstrations, allowing visitors to experience these products’ capabilities firsthand.

These offerings were introduced as key components that significantly enhance the safety and efficiency of electric and autonomous vehicles. Leveraging these technologies, Korea Nitto Denko aims to accelerate innovation in the mobility sector and propose sustainable solutions for the future of transportation.

body.cap: Korea Nitto Denko booth at FIX 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: In addition, the company presented its explosion-proof valves and battery-related materials, which also target the mobility industry. These products are known for improving quality, safety, and efficiency in modern and future mobility systems, setting new benchmarks for the industry.

A representative from Korea Nitto Denko, stated, “We closely monitor the rapidly evolving mobility market trends and adapt to changing customer needs with an advanced technological portfolio. By providing pioneering solutions, we have maintained strong partnerships with mobility and component manufacturers and battery specialists, solidifying our role as a trusted partner in the industry.”

FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
